lecons.title: Editing
lecons.summary: Editing is checking and correcting a written work or text to make it clean, correct and easy to understand. You can change the font size, the page setting, the borders, the background, the text alignment, the capitalisation and the calligraphy.
lecons.illustration_prompt: Figure composée, non générée, dessinée par work/figures-brayne-tic-oct.py. Trois cartes : font size, borders, alignment.
